prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Haqueta de foc, Valencian supernatural pony wrapped in fire.
ANATOMY: ONE living small PONY with one head, TWO eyes, FOUR legs, one mane and one tail; whole pony body is wrapped in real ORANGE FLAMES [haqueta-de-foc-c01]. Short sturdy pony proportions, dark coat under flames. No horns, wings, skeletal face or rider. Fire consumes no flesh; no injuries. Flames arise from body surface itself, not decorative aura ring.
MOMENT: Gallop powerfully down village street toward viewer at midnight, head lowered in forceful charge, nostrils flared, front hooves reaching and hind hooves kicking, flaming mane and tail stream backward. Orange fire physically illuminates wet cobbles, casts sparks and thick smoke into air. All four legs distinct.
POWER: It appears ablaze at midnight [haqueta-de-foc-c01], roams Beneixama village streets making people stay inside [haqueta-de-foc-c04]. Visible body flames are documented, not generic magic glow; no fire from eyes/mouth borrowed from separate Comte Arnau c06.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; low street camera, entire stout pony fills square, doorways show normal pony size, no giant horse.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon or fire source when documented, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, tactile rain or dust.
SURFACE: tactile rough skin, coarse opaque cloth, wet fur, stone and timber; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Empty stone street in Beneixama at midnight [haqueta-de-foc-c04].
MOOD: imposing active confrontation, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Haqueta de foc, Valencian supernatural pony wrapped in fire

visual_requirements.description: Real flames wrap body during midnight appearance

aura: Documented power or action physically changes world; no generic aura.
artistic_choices: Choose riderless midnight street account c01/c04, not knight variation c05. No Comte Arnau borrowed firebreathing c06. Physical fire strongly lights cobbles, no neon aura.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: short sturdy pony with one head/two eyes, four legs in gallop (far hind hoof small beneath torso), physical flame wraps body/mane/tail and casts orange light on wet street. No mouth/eye fire borrowed from Comte Arnau, no rider. Normal pony size against doorways, imposing charge. No text/aura beyond documented fire. All Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and leg and head crops. One sturdy pony: one head, two eyes, two ears, one mane and one tail, and exactly four legs in a gallop (near fore planted at left, off fore raised at centre, two hind legs behind at right). The whole body, mane and tail are wrapped in real orange flames that rise from the coat itself, lighting the wet cobbles and throwing sparks and spray (supernatural pony appearing ablaze at midnight amid a great glow, haqueta-de-foc-c01). It charges at the viewer down a narrow empty stone village street at night, with a church tower and a moon (roaming the Beneixama streets after dark, c04). No rider (c05 not mixed in) and no fire from the eyes or mouth (Comte Arnau, c06, not borrowed). The undersides of the hooves seen from below are painted as hollow rings, a minor painterly oddity, but they still read as hooves. Dangerous and dominant at 200px, no text or borrowed design.
